question: Should `channelData.openclawProgressKind: "tool-progress"` become a supported public Plugin SDK contract for cross-plugin progress intent?
rationale: The marker is exposed to external plugins and directly controls whether Slack suppresses delivery, so its permanent semantics and ownership cannot safely be inferred from implementation alone.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
options.body: Keep the additive generic marker, document allowed producers and channel semantics, add compatibility-focused tests, and obtain Slack or Plugin SDK owner approval.

options.title: Keep progress intent internal
options.body: Remove the public exports and route the intent through an existing internal or portable typed presentation boundary if maintainers do not want an external SDK commitment.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive generic marker, document allowed producers and channel semantics, add compatibility-focused tests, and obtain Slack or Plugin SDK owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal is recent direct review of Slack send and reply-delivery behavior.
